776740103.text: There's definitely something wrong with your balancing. Even if you brought in those combat specialists from the Special Assignments Battalion, nobody would be able to beat it!

776740104.text: Then train harder and reflect on your mistakes. It's not just a shooting simulation, either. Building defensive fortifications is just as important.

776740105.text: But when you demonstrated it yourself, didn't a single mistake cause the whole run to fall apart?

776740106.text: So what? That's exactly how dangerous the Shadow Realm should be.

776740107.text: If it's made even a little easier, ordinary marksmen will start having illusions of competence, thinking, "Maybe I could survive in the Shadow Realm."

776740108.text: So if you don't train to the strictest standards, how can you hope to perform flawlessly in such a brutal environment?

776740110.text: I'm gonna go figure this thing out. No way I'm getting shut out every single run.

776740111.text: Oof, he really got the wind knocked out of his sails...

776740112.text: Looks like your tabletop game really threw him for a loop.

776740115.text: A game? To you, maybe. A fun little pastime, even. But for those who know what the Shadow Realm is, the very premise of the combat simulation is enough to make them uneasy.

776740116.text: I created it as a way to train strategic thinking through simulations.

776740117.text: To the adventurers, hunters, and warriors of Snezhnaya, the Shadow Realm has always been a blade hidden deep within the snowstorms, waiting to strike.

776740118.text: No one knows exactly what's inside. All we can do is piece together scattered scraps of information and try to imagine just how dangerous it might be.

776740119.text: Then we come up with hypothetical battle plans and use them to sharpen our skills. If we're ever unlucky enough to end up in that hellhole, at least we'd stand a better chance of making it out alive.

776740120.text: The problem is, even at my best, I can barely survive a few rounds myself — so what chance do they have...?

776740121.text: Whoa... This is way more serious than Paimon was expecting.

776740122.text: #Still, {NICKNAME} has a ton of experience with this stuff. Should have to be one of the best in Snezhnaya, right?
